title: Open immersions into locally Noetherian schemes are quasi-compact
statement: Let $j:U\to X$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $X$ locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Then $j$ is quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]: the inverse image of every affine open of $X$ is quasi-compact.
